codeHash.description: Content hash for code integrity verification

main.description: Verification record for a lens transformation. The verifier's identity is implicit — the DID of the repo owner who writes this record. Follows the ATProto pattern where verification records live in the verifier's own PDS.

codeHash.description: Hash of the code at the referenced commit. Required for signedHash method.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this verification was issued

description.description: Human-readable description of what was verified

lens.description: AT-URI of the lens record being verified

lensCommit.description: CID of the specific lens record version. Ensures immutability — if the lens is updated, old verifications do not carry over.

proofRef.description: Link to proof artifact (Coq/Lean proof, test suite, etc.). Used with formalProof or automatedTest methods.

verificationMethod.description: What kind of verification was performed
